def transform(grid):
    colors = {v for row in grid for v in row if v != 0}
    pieces = []
    for color in colors:
        cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == color]
        r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in cells), max(r for r, c in cells)
        c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in cells), max(c for r, c in cells)
        piece = [[grid[r][c] for c in range(c0, c1 + 1)] for r in range(r0, r1 + 1)]
        pieces.append((c0, piece))
    pieces.sort(key=lambda item: item[0])
    height = max(len(piece) for _, piece in pieces)
    width = sum(len(piece[0]) for _, piece in pieces)
    out = [[0] * width for _ in range(height)]
    offset = 0
    for _, piece in pieces:
        for r, row in enumerate(piece):
            for c, value in enumerate(row):
                out[r][offset + c] = value
        offset += len(piece[0])
    return out
